body:
## Why

A lead submission belongs to one form block. `pages_edit` renamed the built-in fields in a second form because their names existed elsewhere on the page, so the contact mapper missed the submitted email and phone.

## What changed

- New form blocks use the editor's default fields and exact built-in names. The router still derives their `seq_no` values from the supplied edit time.
- New custom fields take the first unused `custom_field<n>` within their form. The name helper avoids stored names, public input names, and the shared reserved submission names.
- Regression tests insert two forms through `pages_edit`, submit both through the local lead handler, and check their stored leads and contacts.
- The canvas Add field control now uses `nextLeadFormFieldName`, and its regression covers stored and public input names.

Closes #1373.

## Scope

This PR covers draft edits, lead submission behavior, and canvas Add field naming for form blocks. Existing stored field names remain addressable. Undo remains a separate design based on stored prior values. The base dispatcher's overlapping same-`editId` replay race remains a follow-up.

## Blast Radius

The editor and agent now share one default form definition. The reserved-name filter at the submission boundary still drops posted metadata keys, and page and workspace ownership still come from the route and stored page.

## Verification

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm run typecheck`, `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 pnpm test`, and `pnpm run editor:build` passed at the pushed head.
- The LOC check against `origin/main`, guards-table check, and CSS budget check passed.
- The batch dispatcher regressions passed after reproducing the prior failures. The PR preview served the pushed head and passed the three live MCP batch replays.

## Proof

Verified head: `272a2d37736aa6ab8785a542d30ad7e914d18387`. Authenticated doctor confirmed that https://pr-1041.clarity-video.workers.dev served this head. The root test run passed 170 router, 502 workspace-tree, 3,920 editor, and 344 script tests, with one script test skipped. Install, lint, typecheck, editor build, LOC against `origin/main`, guards, and CSS budget passed.

The new dispatcher tests failed on the previous head in seven cases. They cover plan and feature removal, sibling edits after removal, and edits after gapless insertion or duplication. A separate regression failed when a removed plan's remapped address was reused by a later insert. The focused suite now passes 83 tests. The fix keeps survivor sequence values and translates original plan and feature addresses through batch-local renumbering. It reserves every address seen during the batch, including addresses later removed.

Live MCP replay on a new draft passed the three verifier repros. Two plan removals left no plans. Two feature removals left no features on Plan A. Removing Plan A and setting Plan B's title left Plan B at `seq_no` `20` with the new title. `pages_get` confirmed each result, and the page remained a draft. The test page and agent connection were deleted or revoked. Evidence is in `.audit/1041-batch-red.log`, `.audit/1041-remap-red.log`, `.audit/1041-focused-after-review.log`, `.audit/1041-test-final.log`, `.audit/1041-preview-doctor.log`, and `.audit/1041-live-batch.json`.

## Replay rules

A batch applies in order to the current draft. Missing targets refuse. Removing an absent ID and setting an already canonical value are no-ops. A guarded positional edit refuses when its `expect` no longer matches unless the target already holds the requested end state. The same `editId` replays the first result. A fresh `editId` starts a new request. After a refusal, the agent reads `pages_get` again.

## Security

The submission boundary discards all reserved posted names. A submitted block ID can select only an enabled form in the routed page. The route, stored page, and server supply lead metadata.

Part of the overnight editor stack for WIL-3276.
